title: Checkpoint
description: The small durable progress record enabling resume (work.Checkpoint). Everything else is re-derived from git/forge state.

commit.description: The commit a reading Run had checked out from the branch under review. Absent when the Run reviewed the base branch.

instructionFiles.description: Agent instruction and configuration files the worker found in the clone before the harness ran (AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at any depth, .cursorrules, .mcp.json, and everything under .claude/, .agents/ and .openhands/), with the SHA-256 of the content it read.

path.description: Slash-separated path relative to the repository root

limits.description: Sent with the prompt_started phase when the agent's prompt starts (ADR-0114): the limits that stop the prompt. promptSeconds counts from promptStartedAt and idleSeconds from the agent's last activity; an absent or zero limit is no limit. ploegd records the first report once and records nothing when promptStartedAt is more than a few minutes before the Run started or after ploegd's clock.
